story_name: Orpheus Unbound: Music of the Soul
character_description: Orpheus, musician-poet with flowing silver-white hair that moves to inner music, luminous gray eyes holding infinite sorrow and depth, classical Greek robes adorned with lyre strings that glow. Without his lyre, learning strength comes from within, not external power.
setting: Underworld, Greek Isles, and ethereal realms between life and death
theme: Finding that true power comes from within, not from external enchantment

video_prompts: Orpheus stands at gates of Underworld, lyre destroyed by grief-maddened maenads. His silver-white hair flows with sorrow as he confronts loss of both love and power.
first_frame_prompt: Orpheus kneels at Underworld gates, lyre shattered at his feet. His silver-white hair flows upward as if moved by inner wind. Luminous gray eyes stream with tears that manifest as light touching ground. Without magic music, his form seems diminished yet somehow more authentically human. The destroyed lyre represents loss of external power.
speech: My magic is gone. I am just a man now, and it seems man is not enough.

video_prompts: Underworld beings are moved not by music but by Orpheus's unfiltered human pain and courage.

speech: I cannot enchant you. I can only show you my breaking heart.
